posts.content_md:
I made my first transmission hologram yesterday. Wow!

Really amazing how much brighter and more detailed and deeper it is than the primitive Denisyuks I've been doing up until this point

posts.author: BobH
posts.content_md:
Congratulations! 

Laser lit holograms are the best, and really only available to those who make their own. Make some with the objects waaay back behind the plate (keeping the path lengths equal though). Viewing them is like looking through a magic window! 8)

posts.author: eric343
posts.content_md:
> **BobH:** Laser lit holograms are the best, and really only available to those who make their own.

When you think about it, this doesn't make an awful lot of sense. Back when lasers were esoteric and pricey, sure -- but nowdays with <$1 laser pointers on eBay, laser lit holograms are a lot easier to view than they once were.

And even under white light, transmission holograms look ghostly and cool
